mapper.sql: select u.id as user_id, u.username, u.display_name, u.email, u.password_hash, u.must_change_password, u.auth_version, coalesce(string_agg(distinct b.role_code, ','), '') as role_codes from iam_user u left join rbac_role_binding b on b.subject_type = 'USER' and b.subject_id = u.id and b.status = 'ENABLED' and b.deleted_at is null and (b.expires_at is null or b.expires_at > now())
mapper.select: where u.username = #{username} and u.status = 'ENABLED' and u.deleted_at is null group by u.id limit 1
where u.id = #{userId} and u.status = 'ENABLED' and u.deleted_at is null group by u.id limit 1
mapper.update: update iam_user set password_hash = #{passwordHash}, must_change_password = false, auth_version = auth_version + 1, updated_by = #{updatedBy}, updated_at = now() where id = #{userId} and status = 'ENABLED' and deleted_at is null
mapper.insert: insert into iam_session ( id, user_id, session_token_hash, refresh_token_hash, auth_version, expires_at ) values ( #{sessionId}, #{userId}, #{accessTokenHash}, #{refreshTokenHash}, #{authVersion}, #{expiresAt} )
mapper.select: select id, user_id, refresh_token_hash, auth_version, expires_at, revoked_at is not null as revoked from iam_session where refresh_token_hash = #{refreshTokenHash} limit 1
mapper.update: update iam_session set revoked_at = coalesce(revoked_at, now()), revoked_by = coalesce(revoked_by, #{revokedBy}), revoke_reason = coalesce(revoke_reason, #{reason}) where id = #{sessionId}
